team.abilityDesc: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.desc: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.desc: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall asleep.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.desc: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.desc: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.

team.abilityDesc: The Pokémon draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.

moves.name: Scald
moves.desc: The user attacks by shooting boiling hot water at the target. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Recover
moves.desc: The user regenerates its cells, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.desc: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.desc: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

team.abilityDesc: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.desc: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

moves.name: Hex
moves.desc: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.desc: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Disable
moves.desc: For four turns, the target will be unable to use whichever move it last used.

team.abilityDesc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's move if it is the last to act that turn.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.desc: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.desc: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Magnet Rise
moves.desc: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
